text: This is Uberdoer, a task manager for Mac, iPhone and iPad, built to replace OmniFocus. Everything you capture lands in the Inbox first, ready to be sorted.

Quick Entry opens from any app with Control, Option, Space. Type the action, then press Tab to choose a project. Tab again for tags. Space flags it. One more Tab sets the due date, and words like tomorrow or Friday just work.
Projects live in folders. Pick one to see what's left to do, and complete a whole project straight from the sidebar.
Forecast lays out what's due and planned, day by day, so the week ahead is clear at a glance.
The Board shows the same actions as a Kanban board, with a column for each stage of the work.
Tags work as contexts. Choose Calls or Errands, and you see everything you can do right there.
Every change syncs through iCloud without conflicts, even after editing offline. And because Uberdoer speaks MCP, your AI assistants can file reminders and tick off tasks for you.
